subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack gain a new default-off tool-use-sensitive reply policy, and if so what precedence should it have relative to replyToMode, per-channel overrides, DMs, existing threads, and explicit top-level opt-outs?
rationale: The source proof shows the feature is absent, but adding a new config key and reply-routing heuristic changes a compatibility-sensitive channel behavior that repository policy reserves for maintainer product direction.

options.title: Approve a precise Slack policy
options.body: Define the exact config shape and precedence, then allow a focused Slack plugin implementation with docs and tests.

options.title: Use existing static replyToMode controls
options.body: Keep this open only as design context or close later if maintainers decide static per-channel reply modes are the supported solution.

options.title: Fold into broader reply threading design
options.body: Defer this heuristic until the always-threaded or multi-channel reply-policy work has a unified contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a precise Slack policy
recommendation.body: Define the exact config shape and precedence, then allow a focused Slack plugin implementation with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and contributed the closest current Slack reply-mode changes and is the strongest history-backed owner for the product-direction call.
